verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a built-in, first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues. It also aims for Sentry API compatibility, so an agent can pull and triage production errors via MCP or API. Filing bugs into a tracker is not documented from GlitchTip's side and would rely on the agent's own tracker tooling. Missing for 10: documented issue-tracker linking or creation from GlitchTip, explicit ranking of top issues by frequency or impact, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.
